_comment: Photographer-oriented descriptions of Camera Raw (crs:) settings, keyed by tag name. Written from docs/adobe-docs/*.md (digests of Adobe's help). Where Adobe's help does not say something, the text says so instead of guessing. Ranges and defaults are NOT stored here: they come from amb-presets/data/tags.json. 'band_templates' expand to one entry per colour band ({band} = Red, {band_lower} = red).

metadata.label: Preset metadata
metadata.description: Describes the preset or sidecar itself (name, group, UUID, Amount-slider support). Not an edit; never changes how the photo looks.

process.label: Process version
process.description: The Camera Raw processing technology. It decides which tone controls exist (PV2012 and later: Exposure2012..Blacks2012; PV2010/2003: the legacy controls). Updating it can change the look significantly.

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: The colour and tone foundation (Adobe Color, Adobe Monochrome, Camera Matching, creative profiles). Applying a profile does not change any slider values.

white_balance.label: Basic: White balance
white_balance.description: White balance preset, Temp and Tint. Raw files use a Kelvin Temp scale; JPEG/TIFF use an approximate -100..100 scale (the Incremental* tags).

tone.label: Basic: Tone
tone.description: Global tone controls for process version 2012 and later: Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks.

tone_legacy.label: Basic: Tone (legacy PV2010/PV2003)
tone_legacy.description: Tone controls of the old process versions. Only meaningful for photos still on PV2010/PV2003. For current edits use the 'tone' and 'presence' groups (Exposure2012, Contrast2012, Clarity2012, ...).

presence.label: Basic: Presence
presence.description: Texture, Clarity, Dehaze, Vibrance and Saturation.

tone_curve.label: Tone Curve
tone_curve.description: Parametric curve (four region sliders and three split points) and point curves (combined RGB plus Red, Green and Blue channels). Input on the horizontal axis, output on the vertical; a straight 45-degree line means no change.

hsl.label: Color Mixer: HSL
hsl.description: Hue, Saturation and Luminance per colour band (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Aqua, Blue, Purple, Magenta). Each slider affects all similar colours in the photo.

bw_mixer.label: Black & White
bw_mixer.description: Black & white treatment and the B&W Mix: how light or dark each colour band becomes in grey.

point_color.label: Color Mixer: Point Color
point_color.description: Targeted changes to one sampled colour (up to eight swatches): Hue/Saturation/Luminance Shift, Variance and Range.

color_grading.label: Color Grading
color_grading.description: Colour wheels for Shadows, Midtones, Highlights and Global (hue, saturation, luminance each), plus Blending. Balance is stored in SplitToningBalance.

split_toning.label: Split Toning (legacy) and Color Grading Balance
split_toning.description: The pre-2020 Split Toning controls. Camera Raw reuses SplitToningBalance as the Color Grading Balance slider.

detail.label: Detail
detail.description: Sharpening (Amount, Radius, Detail, Masking) and manual noise reduction (luminance and colour). Judge these at 100% zoom or more.

lut.label: LUT
lut.description: A look from a .cube file (the 3D LUT format of Resolve and many look packs), applied after the colour and curves. Our own feature (amb: namespace); Lightroom has no LUT setting and ignores these.

negative.label: Film Negative (Ambrotype)
negative.description: Turns a camera scan of a film negative into a positive: removes the orange film base, sets per-channel levels, and applies a film stock look. Our own feature (amb: namespace); Lightroom has no equivalent tags, so Lightroom ignores these.

lens.label: Lens Corrections
lens.description: Lens profile corrections, chromatic-aberration removal, defringing and lens vignetting.

transform.label: Transform
transform.description: Upright perspective correction and manual perspective sliders.

effects.label: Effects
effects.description: Post-crop vignette (styles, Amount, Midpoint, Roundness, Feather, Highlights) and film grain (Amount, Size, Roughness).

calibration.label: Calibration
calibration.description: Shadows tint and the red, green and blue primary hue/saturation adjustments to the camera's default colour rendering.

crop.label: Crop
crop.description: Crop rectangle, angle and orientation. Specific to one image; presets should rarely carry it.

local.label: Masks and local adjustments
local.description: Masks (AI, brush, linear and radial gradients, range masks) with their local adjustment sliders. Stored as nested structures.

retouch.label: Remove, heal and red eye
retouch.description: Spot/remove and red-eye data with image coordinates. Specific to one image and not applied from presets.

enhance.label: Enhance (AI)
enhance.description: Records of AI Denoise, Raw Details and Super Resolution. Not supported by Ambrotype.

lens_blur.label: Lens Blur (AI)
lens_blur.description: Depth-map based background blur with bokeh shapes. Not supported by Ambrotype.

hdr.label: HDR editing
hdr.description: HDR edit mode and the SDR rendition settings used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output. Not supported by Ambrotype.

band_templates.label: Hue: {band}
band_templates.description: Shifts the hue of {band_lower} colours in the photo (changes the colour itself, e.g. a blue sky towards cyan or purple). 0 = unchanged.

band_templates.label: Saturation: {band}
band_templates.description: Vividness or purity of {band_lower} colours. Negative mutes them, positive intensifies them. 0 = unchanged.

band_templates.label: Luminance: {band}
band_templates.description: Brightness of {band_lower} colours. Negative darkens them, positive lightens them. 0 = unchanged.

band_templates.label: B&W Mix: {band}
band_templates.description: In a black & white conversion, how light or dark {band_lower} areas of the original become in grey. Negative darkens, positive lightens. Only has an effect when ConvertToGrayscale is True.

Name.label: Preset name
Name.description: Display name of the preset (an XMP language alternative or plain text).

Group.label: Preset group
Group.description: The group (folder) the preset is listed under.

Cluster.label: Preset cluster
Cluster.description: Adobe preset grouping key used alongside Group.

ShortName.label: Short name
ShortName.description: Short display name of the preset.

SortName.label: Sort name
SortName.description: Name used to sort the preset in lists.

ContactInfo.label: Contact info
ContactInfo.description: Contact information of the preset author.

PresetType.label: Preset type
PresetType.description: Kind of preset, e.g. Normal. Its presence marks an XMP file as a preset rather than a sidecar.

CameraModelRestriction.label: Camera restriction
CameraModelRestriction.description: Camera model the preset is restricted to (e.g. for camera-specific profiles).

SupportsAmount.label: Supports Amount slider
SupportsAmount.description: True when the preset may be applied with the Amount slider. When False, Lightroom greys the slider out.

SupportsColor.label: Supports colour photos
SupportsColor.description: Whether the preset is meant for colour photos.

SupportsMonochrome.label: Supports monochrome photos
SupportsMonochrome.description: Whether the preset is meant for monochrome photos.

SupportsHighDynamicRange.label: Supports HDR
SupportsHighDynamicRange.description: Whether the preset supports HDR edits.

SupportsNormalDynamicRange.label: Supports SDR
SupportsNormalDynamicRange.description: Whether the preset supports standard dynamic range edits.

SupportsSceneReferred.label: Supports scene-referred
SupportsSceneReferred.description: Whether the preset supports scene-referred (raw-like) images.

SupportsOutputReferred.label: Supports output-referred
SupportsOutputReferred.description: Whether the preset supports output-referred (JPEG/TIFF-like) images.

HasSettings.label: Has settings
HasSettings.description: Whether the file carries develop settings.

RequiresRGBTables.label: Requires RGB tables
RequiresRGBTables.description: Whether the preset needs embedded RGB lookup tables (Table_* entries).

RawFileName.label: Raw file name
RawFileName.description: File name of the raw the sidecar belongs to.

Version.label: Writer version
Version.description: Version of the Camera Raw engine that wrote the file.

CompatibleVersion.label: Compatible version
CompatibleVersion.description: Oldest Camera Raw version that can read the settings.

ProcessVersion.label: Process version
ProcessVersion.description: Camera Raw process version as a version string (e.g. "15.4"). It decides which tone controls apply; Adobe's help does not list the numeric identifiers.

AlreadyApplied.label: Already applied
AlreadyApplied.description: Marks settings that were already baked into the pixels (e.g. a rendered file).

CameraProfile.label: Profile
CameraProfile.description: Name of the camera profile, e.g. "Adobe Color" (Lightroom's default for raw photos), "Adobe Standard", "Camera Standard", or one you made. Ambrotype renders DNG Camera Profiles (.dcp) found on this computer for the photo's camera (Camera Raw's profile folders, AMB_DCP_DIRS); other names keep Ambrotype's default look and are reported. Applying a profile does not change slider values.

CameraProfileDigest.label: Profile digest
CameraProfileDigest.description: Checksum identifying the exact camera profile.

Look.label: Look (creative profile)
Look.description: Creative profile (Artistic, B&W, Modern, Vintage, ...) stored as a structure with its name, parameters and Amount.

RGBTable.label: RGB table
RGBTable.description: Reference to an embedded RGB lookup table used by a profile or look.

LookTable.label: Look table
LookTable.description: Reference to an embedded look table used by a profile.

OverrideLookVignette.label: Override look vignette
OverrideLookVignette.description: Whether the photo's own vignette settings override the one built into a creative profile.

WhiteBalance.label: White balance preset
WhiteBalance.description: "As Shot" (the camera's setting), "Auto" (computed from the image), or for raw/DNG "Daylight", "Cloudy", "Shade", "Tungsten", "Fluorescent", "Flash"; "Custom" when Temp/Tint were set by hand. Temperature and Tint only take effect when this is not "As Shot" (Ambrotype's edit commands switch it to "Custom" when you set Temp or Tint).

Temperature.label: Temp
Temperature.description: Colour temperature in Kelvin for raw files: lower values make the photo cooler (bluer), higher values warmer (more yellow). Example: 3200 K suits tungsten light. Adobe documents 2000-50000 K (newer versions go down to 1500 K). No default: As Shot depends on the camera's recorded white balance.

Tint.label: Tint
Tint.description: Green/magenta balance: negative adds green, positive adds magenta. 0 = neutral relative to the white balance preset.

IncrementalTemperature.label: Temp (non-raw)
IncrementalTemperature.description: Temp for JPEG/TIFF/PSD files, on an approximate -100..100 scale instead of Kelvin: negative cooler, positive warmer.

IncrementalTint.label: Tint (non-raw)
IncrementalTint.description: Tint for JPEG/TIFF/PSD files on a -100..100 scale: negative greener, positive more magenta.

Exposure2012.label: Exposure
Exposure2012.description: Overall brightness in stops. Each +1.00 doubles the light, roughly one aperture stop more; each -1.00 halves it.

Contrast2012.label: Contrast
Contrast2012.description: Mainly affects midtones. Increasing it makes middle-to-dark areas darker and middle-to-light areas lighter; decreasing it flattens the image.

Highlights2012.label: Highlights
Highlights2012.description: Adjusts bright areas. Negative darkens highlights and recovers blown-out detail; positive brightens them while minimising clipping.

Shadows2012.label: Shadows
Shadows2012.description: Adjusts dark areas. Negative darkens shadows while minimising clipping; positive brightens them and recovers shadow detail.

Whites2012.label: Whites
Whites2012.description: Adjusts white clipping. Negative reduces clipping in highlights; positive increases it (sometimes desirable for specular highlights).

Blacks2012.label: Blacks
Blacks2012.description: Adjusts black clipping. Negative maps more shadows to pure black (deeper blacks); positive reduces shadow clipping (lifts the black point).

AutoTone.label: Auto tone
AutoTone.description: True when the tone sliders were set by Auto, which maximises the tonal scale and minimises clipping for that particular image.

Exposure.label: Exposure (legacy)
Exposure.description: PV2010/PV2003 Exposure, in stops. For current process versions use Exposure2012.

Brightness.label: Brightness (legacy)
Brightness.description: PV2010/PV2003 Brightness: mainly midtones; moving right compresses highlights and expands shadows. No PV2012 equivalent; use Exposure2012 and the tone curve.

Contrast.label: Contrast (legacy)
Contrast.description: PV2010/PV2003 Contrast, mainly affecting midtones. For current process versions use Contrast2012.

Shadows.label: Blacks (legacy)
Shadows.description: The PV2010/PV2003 Blacks slider: which image values map to black, with the greatest effect in the shadows. For current process versions use Blacks2012 (and Shadows2012 for shadow brightness).

HighlightRecovery.label: Recovery (legacy)
HighlightRecovery.description: PV2010/PV2003 Recovery: reduces extreme highlights and can recover detail when one or two channels are clipped. For current process versions use Highlights2012.

FillLight.label: Fill Light (legacy)
FillLight.description: PV2010/PV2003 Fill Light: lightens shadows while keeping blacks; may reveal noise. For current process versions use Shadows2012.

Clarity.label: Clarity (legacy)
Clarity.description: PV2010 Clarity. For current process versions use Clarity2012.

Texture.label: Texture
Texture.description: Smooths (negative) or accentuates (positive) textured detail without changing colour or tonality.

Clarity2012.label: Clarity
Clarity2012.description: Local contrast, like a large-radius unsharp mask that acts mostly on midtones. Positive values add depth and punch; too much draws light or dark rims (halos) along strong edges. Negative values soften local contrast.

Dehaze.label: Dehaze
Dehaze.description: Positive removes haze; negative adds haze for a softer, misty look.

Vibrance.label: Vibrance
Vibrance.description: Raises the saturation of lower-saturated colours with less effect on already saturated ones, minimising clipping and keeping skin tones from becoming oversaturated.

Saturation.label: Saturation
Saturation.description: Saturation of all colours equally: -100 is monochrome, +100 doubles the saturation.

ToneCurveName2012.label: Point curve preset
ToneCurveName2012.description: Name of the point curve preset: "Linear", "Medium Contrast", "Strong Contrast", or "Custom". The preset is reflected in the point curve, not in the region sliders.

ToneCurvePV2012.label: Point curve (RGB)
ToneCurvePV2012.description: Combined RGB point curve as a list of "input, output" points on a 0-255 scale (e.g. [[0,0],[64,56],[192,200],[255,255]] for gentle contrast). [[0,0],[255,255]] is the straight 45-degree line: no change. Raising the first point's output lifts (fades) the blacks; lowering the last point's output dims the whites.

ToneCurvePV2012Red.label: Point curve (Red)
ToneCurvePV2012Red.description: Red-channel point curve, same format as ToneCurvePV2012. Raising it adds red, lowering it adds cyan, in the tones the points cover.

ToneCurvePV2012Green.label: Point curve (Green)
ToneCurvePV2012Green.description: Green-channel point curve, same format as ToneCurvePV2012. Raising it adds green, lowering it adds magenta, in the tones the points cover.

ToneCurvePV2012Blue.label: Point curve (Blue)
ToneCurvePV2012Blue.description: Blue-channel point curve, same format as ToneCurvePV2012. Raising it adds blue, lowering it adds yellow, in the tones the points cover.

ToneCurve.label: Point curve (legacy)
ToneCurve.description: PV2010/PV2003 point curve. For current process versions use ToneCurvePV2012.

ParametricShadows.label: Curve: Shadows
ParametricShadows.description: Parametric curve region slider for the darkest end of the tonal range. Negative darkens, positive lightens.

ParametricDarks.label: Curve: Darks
ParametricDarks.description: Parametric curve region slider for the darker middle region. Negative darkens, positive lightens.

ParametricLights.label: Curve: Lights
ParametricLights.description: Parametric curve region slider for the lighter middle region. Negative darkens, positive lightens.

ParametricHighlights.label: Curve: Highlights
ParametricHighlights.description: Parametric curve region slider for the brightest end of the tonal range. Negative darkens, positive lightens.

ParametricShadowSplit.label: Curve: Shadows/Darks split
ParametricShadowSplit.description: Position of the boundary between the Shadows and Darks regions, as a percentage of the tonal range.

ParametricMidtoneSplit.label: Curve: Darks/Lights split
ParametricMidtoneSplit.description: Position of the boundary between the Darks and Lights regions, as a percentage of the tonal range.

ParametricHighlightSplit.label: Curve: Lights/Highlights split
ParametricHighlightSplit.description: Position of the boundary between the Lights and Highlights regions, as a percentage of the tonal range.

ConvertToGrayscale.label: Treatment: Black & White
ConvertToGrayscale.description: True converts the photo to black & white (the B&W Mix sliders then set each colour's grey tone); False keeps colour.

AutoGrayscaleMix.label: Auto B&W mix
AutoGrayscaleMix.description: True when the B&W Mix was set by Auto, which maximises the distribution of grey tones for that image.

PointColors.label: Point Color swatches
PointColors.description: List of Point Color swatches (sampled colour, Hue/Saturation/Luminance Shift, Variance, Range). Edit through presets; structure is not documented by Adobe.

ColorGradeShadowHue.label: Grading: Shadows hue
ColorGradeShadowHue.description: Hue of the tint added to shadows, as an angle on the colour wheel (0-359). Has no effect while ColorGradeShadowSat is 0.

ColorGradeShadowSat.label: Grading: Shadows saturation
ColorGradeShadowSat.description: Strength of the shadows tint: 0 = none, 100 = strongest.

ColorGradeShadowLum.label: Grading: Shadows luminance
ColorGradeShadowLum.description: Brightness of the shadows: negative darkens, positive lightens.

ColorGradeMidtoneHue.label: Grading: Midtones hue
ColorGradeMidtoneHue.description: Hue of the tint added to midtones (0-359 on the colour wheel). Has no effect while ColorGradeMidtoneSat is 0.

ColorGradeMidtoneSat.label: Grading: Midtones saturation
ColorGradeMidtoneSat.description: Strength of the midtones tint: 0 = none, 100 = strongest.

ColorGradeMidtoneLum.label: Grading: Midtones luminance
ColorGradeMidtoneLum.description: Brightness of the midtones: negative darkens, positive lightens.

ColorGradeHighlightHue.label: Grading: Highlights hue
ColorGradeHighlightHue.description: Hue of the tint added to highlights (0-359 on the colour wheel). Has no effect while ColorGradeHighlightSat is 0.

ColorGradeHighlightSat.label: Grading: Highlights saturation
ColorGradeHighlightSat.description: Strength of the highlights tint: 0 = none, 100 = strongest.

ColorGradeHighlightLum.label: Grading: Highlights luminance
ColorGradeHighlightLum.description: Brightness of the highlights: negative darkens, positive lightens.

ColorGradeGlobalHue.label: Grading: Global hue
ColorGradeGlobalHue.description: Hue of a tint applied to the whole image (0-359), without changing the shadows/midtones/highlights wheels. Has no effect while ColorGradeGlobalSat is 0.

ColorGradeGlobalSat.label: Grading: Global saturation
ColorGradeGlobalSat.description: Strength of the global tint: 0 = none, 100 = strongest.

ColorGradeGlobalLum.label: Grading: Global luminance
ColorGradeGlobalLum.description: Overall brightness change from the global wheel: negative darkens, positive lightens.

ColorGradeBlending.label: Grading: Blending
ColorGradeBlending.description: Amount of overlap (smoothness of the transition) between the shadows, midtones and highlights wheels. Higher values maximise the overlap.

SplitToningShadowHue.label: Split toning: Shadows hue
SplitToningShadowHue.description: Legacy split-toning shadow hue (0-359). Current Lightroom shows it as the Color Grading shadows wheel.

SplitToningHighlightHue.label: Split toning: Highlights hue
SplitToningHighlightHue.description: Legacy split-toning highlight hue (0-359). Current Lightroom shows it as the Color Grading highlights wheel.

SplitToningBalance.label: Grading: Balance
SplitToningBalance.description: Color Grading (and legacy split toning) Balance. Above zero the highlight colour dominates; below zero the shadow colour does.

Sharpness.label: Sharpening: Amount
Sharpness.description: Edge definition: increases contrast between pixels that differ from their neighbours. 0 turns sharpening off. Part of the camera default applied at import.

SharpenRadius.label: Sharpening: Radius
SharpenRadius.description: How wide the sharpened edges are. Small values suit fine texture; large values start to look artificial.

SharpenDetail.label: Sharpening: Detail
SharpenDetail.description: Which detail gets sharpened. At low values only clear edges are sharpened; at high values fine texture (skin, fabric, foliage) is sharpened too.

SharpenEdgeMasking.label: Sharpening: Masking
SharpenEdgeMasking.description: Edge mask: 0 sharpens everything equally; 100 restricts sharpening mostly to the areas near the strongest edges.

LuminanceNoiseReductionDetail.label: Noise reduction: Detail
LuminanceNoiseReductionDetail.description: Luminance noise threshold. Higher preserves more detail but may leave more noise; lower gives cleaner results but may remove some detail.

LuminanceNoiseReductionContrast.label: Noise reduction: Contrast
LuminanceNoiseReductionContrast.description: How much local contrast noise reduction keeps. Raising it keeps more contrast but can leave blotchy noise; lowering it smooths more and flattens contrast.

ColorNoiseReductionDetail.label: Color noise reduction: Detail
ColorNoiseReductionDetail.description: Colour noise threshold. Higher protects thin, detailed colour edges but may leave colour speckling; lower removes speckles but may cause colour bleeding.

ColorNoiseReductionSmoothness.label: Color noise reduction: Smoothness
ColorNoiseReductionSmoothness.description: Smoothness sub-slider of colour noise reduction. Adobe's help names it without describing it further.

LensProfileEnable.label: Enable profile corrections
LensProfileEnable.description: True applies the lens profile matched from the camera and lens metadata (distortion and vignetting correction).

AutoLateralCA.label: Remove chromatic aberration
AutoLateralCA.description: True automatically corrects blue-yellow and red-green lateral colour fringes.

LensProfileSetup.label: Lens profile setup
LensProfileSetup.description: How the lens profile was chosen (e.g. automatic or custom).

LensProfileName.label: Lens profile
LensProfileName.description: Name of the lens profile in use.

LensProfileFilename.label: Lens profile file
LensProfileFilename.description: File name of the lens profile (.lcp).

LensProfileDigest.label: Lens profile digest
LensProfileDigest.description: Checksum identifying the exact lens profile.

LensProfileDistortionScale.label: Profile: Distortion
LensProfileDistortionScale.description: How much of the profile's distortion correction is applied: 100 = 100% of the profile, above 100 corrects more, below 100 less.

LensProfileVignettingScale.label: Profile: Vignetting
LensProfileVignettingScale.description: How much of the profile's vignetting correction is applied: 100 = 100% of the profile, above 100 corrects more, below 100 less.

LensProfileChromaticAberrationScale.label: Profile: Chromatic aberration
LensProfileChromaticAberrationScale.description: Scale of the profile's chromatic-aberration correction, 100 = as profiled. Not described in Adobe's help.

LensManualDistortionAmount.label: Manual: Distortion
LensManualDistortionAmount.description: Manual distortion correction: positive corrects barrel distortion, negative corrects pincushion distortion.

VignetteAmount.label: Lens vignetting: Amount
VignetteAmount.description: Manual lens vignetting correction: positive lightens the corners, negative darkens them. See PostCropVignetteAmount for a creative vignette relative to the crop.

VignetteMidpoint.label: Lens vignetting: Midpoint
VignetteMidpoint.description: Midpoint of the manual lens vignetting correction. Adobe's help names it without further detail.

DefringePurpleAmount.label: Defringe: Purple amount
DefringePurpleAmount.description: Strength of purple fringe removal along high-contrast edges (handles longitudinal chromatic aberration). 0 = off.

DefringeGreenAmount.label: Defringe: Green amount
DefringeGreenAmount.description: Strength of green fringe removal along high-contrast edges. 0 = off.

DefringePurpleHueLo.label: Defringe: Purple hue (low)
DefringePurpleHueLo.description: Lower end of the hue range treated as purple fringing. The two ends stay at least 10 units apart.

DefringePurpleHueHi.label: Defringe: Purple hue (high)
DefringePurpleHueHi.description: Upper end of the hue range treated as purple fringing. The two ends stay at least 10 units apart.

DefringeGreenHueLo.label: Defringe: Green hue (low)
DefringeGreenHueLo.description: Lower end of the hue range treated as green fringing. The default range is narrow to protect green/yellow subjects such as foliage.

DefringeGreenHueHi.label: Defringe: Green hue (high)
DefringeGreenHueHi.description: Upper end of the hue range treated as green fringing. The default range is narrow to protect green/yellow subjects such as foliage.

PerspectiveUpright.label: Upright mode
PerspectiveUpright.description: Automatic perspective correction: 0 Off, 1 Auto (balanced, not all the way), 2 Level (rotation only), 3 Vertical (level and vertical perspective), 4 Full (level, vertical and horizontal perspective), 5 Guided (Lightroom's own guides, which we can't read, so it is left off; our editor's Guided tool sets the Transform sliders instead). The correction is found from the photo's own straight lines, after the lens corrections, and the Transform sliders apply on top of it.

amb:UprightGuides.label: Upright guides
amb:UprightGuides.description: The guides drawn with the editor's Guided Upright tool, as 'x1,y1,x2,y2' per guide (fractions of the uncropped photo in its stored orientation, before Transform), separated by ';'. Only kept so the guides can be edited again: the correction itself is in the Vertical, Horizontal and Rotate sliders, which Lightroom reads too.

PerspectiveVertical.label: Transform: Vertical
PerspectiveVertical.description: Vertical perspective correction: negative widens the top, which straightens verticals that lean together in a photo taken looking up; positive widens the bottom.

PerspectiveHorizontal.label: Transform: Horizontal
PerspectiveHorizontal.description: Horizontal perspective correction: positive makes the right side taller, negative the left side.

PerspectiveRotate.label: Transform: Rotate
PerspectiveRotate.description: Rotation around the centre of the original, uncropped photo.

PerspectiveAspect.label: Transform: Aspect
PerspectiveAspect.description: Stretches the photo: positive vertically, negative horizontally. Use it after a strong perspective correction to restore proportions.

PerspectiveScale.label: Transform: Scale
PerspectiveScale.description: Scales the transformed image up or down; 100 = unchanged.

UprightVersion.label: Upright version
UprightVersion.description: Version of the Upright analysis. Computed per image.

UprightCenterMode.label: Upright centre mode
UprightCenterMode.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightCenterNormX.label: Upright centre X
UprightCenterNormX.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightCenterNormY.label: Upright centre Y
UprightCenterNormY.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightFocalMode.label: Upright focal mode
UprightFocalMode.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightFocalLength35mm.label: Upright focal length
UprightFocalLength35mm.description: Upright analysis data (35 mm equivalent focal length), computed per image.

UprightPreview.label: Upright preview
UprightPreview.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightTransformCount.label: Upright transform count
UprightTransformCount.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightFourSegmentsCount.label: Upright segment count
UprightFourSegmentsCount.description: Upright analysis data, computed per image.

UprightDependentDigest.label: Upright digest
UprightDependentDigest.description: Upright analysis checksum, computed per image.

UprightGuidedDependentDigest.label: Upright guided digest
UprightGuidedDependentDigest.description: Guided Upright checksum, computed per image.

UprightTransform_0.label: Upright transform 0
UprightTransform_0.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

UprightTransform_1.label: Upright transform 1
UprightTransform_1.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

UprightTransform_2.label: Upright transform 2
UprightTransform_2.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

UprightTransform_3.label: Upright transform 3
UprightTransform_3.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

UprightTransform_4.label: Upright transform 4
UprightTransform_4.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

UprightTransform_5.label: Upright transform 5
UprightTransform_5.description: Precomputed Upright transform for one mode, computed per image.

PostCropVignetteAmount.label: Vignette: Amount
PostCropVignetteAmount.description: Creative vignette relative to the crop: negative darkens the corners, positive lightens them. 0 = off.

PostCropVignetteMidpoint.label: Vignette: Midpoint
PostCropVignetteMidpoint.description: Where the vignette starts. Low values reach far into the frame; high values confine it to the corners.

PostCropVignetteFeather.label: Vignette: Feather
PostCropVignetteFeather.description: Softness of the vignette edge: lower values soften less (harder edge).

PostCropVignetteRoundness.label: Vignette: Roundness
PostCropVignetteRoundness.description: Positive makes the vignette more circular, negative more oval.

PostCropVignetteHighlightContrast.label: Vignette: Highlights
PostCropVignetteHighlightContrast.description: Keeps bright spots bright inside a darkening vignette (negative Amount, Highlight Priority and Color Priority styles only). Useful for small light sources such as lamps.

PostCropVignetteStyle.label: Vignette: Style
PostCropVignetteStyle.description: Highlight Priority (protects highlight contrast, may shift colours in darkened areas), Color Priority (preserves hues, may lose detail in bright highlights) or Paint Overlay (blends with black or white; can look flat). Stored as a number; the 1 = Highlight Priority, 2 = Color Priority, 3 = Paint Overlay encoding is Camera Raw's XMP convention, not stated in Adobe's help.

GrainAmount.label: Grain: Amount
GrainAmount.description: Strength of simulated film grain. 0 = off.

GrainSize.label: Grain: Size
GrainSize.description: Grain particle size. At 25 or more Adobe adds blue to work better with noise reduction, and such sizes can cause some image blurring.

GrainFrequency.label: Grain: Roughness
GrainFrequency.description: Grain regularity: lower is more uniform, higher more uneven. Together with Size it sets the grain's character.

GrainSeed.label: Grain seed
GrainSeed.description: Random seed of the grain pattern, specific to one image.

ShadowTint.label: Calibration: Shadows
ShadowTint.description: Corrects a green or magenta tint in the shadows: positive adds magenta, negative green. Midtones and highlights are left alone.

RedHue.label: Calibration: Red primary hue
RedHue.description: Shifts the hue of the red primary: positive toward yellow, negative toward magenta. Every colour with red in it moves with it; white stays white. Adjust hue first, then saturation.

RedSaturation.label: Calibration: Red primary saturation
RedSaturation.description: Saturation of the red primary; negative desaturates.

GreenHue.label: Calibration: Green primary hue
GreenHue.description: Shifts the hue of the green primary: positive toward cyan, negative toward yellow. Every colour with green in it moves with it; white stays white. Adjust hue first, then saturation.

GreenSaturation.label: Calibration: Green primary saturation
GreenSaturation.description: Saturation of the green primary; negative desaturates.

BlueHue.label: Calibration: Blue primary hue
BlueHue.description: Shifts the hue of the blue primary: positive toward magenta, negative toward cyan. Every colour with blue in it moves with it; white stays white. Adjust hue first, then saturation.

BlueSaturation.label: Calibration: Blue primary saturation
BlueSaturation.description: Saturation of the blue primary; negative desaturates.

HasCrop.label: Has crop
HasCrop.description: True when the crop (CropLeft/Top/Right/Bottom and CropAngle) is applied. When false the whole photo is shown; the crop values are kept but ignored.

CropConstrainToWarp.label: Constrain crop
CropConstrainToWarp.description: Trim the crop automatically to remove blank or distorted edges after lens and transform corrections.

CropConstrainToUnitSquare.label: Constrain to image
CropConstrainToUnitSquare.description: Keep the crop inside the image bounds.

CropTop.label: Crop top
CropTop.description: Vertical position of the crop's top-left corner, as a fraction of the photo height (0 = top). Measured on the lens-corrected photo in its stored orientation, before the camera's rotation (EXIF orientation) is applied.

CropLeft.label: Crop left
CropLeft.description: Horizontal position of the crop's top-left corner, as a fraction of the photo width (0 = left). Measured on the lens-corrected photo in its stored orientation, before the camera's rotation (EXIF orientation) is applied.

CropBottom.label: Crop bottom
CropBottom.description: Vertical position of the crop's bottom-right corner, as a fraction of the photo height (1 = bottom). Same frame as CropTop.

CropRight.label: Crop right
CropRight.description: Horizontal position of the crop's bottom-right corner, as a fraction of the photo width (1 = right). Same frame as CropLeft.

CropAngle.label: Crop angle
CropAngle.description: Straighten: turns the crop rectangle over the photo, so the result comes out rotated by this angle (Ambrotype reads positive as counter-clockwise, following darktable's Lightroom importer; not yet verified against Lightroom). The crop corners stay two opposite corners of the turned rectangle, and the output size is that rectangle's size.

CropWidth.label: Crop width
CropWidth.description: Requested output width for an aspect-constrained crop.

CropHeight.label: Crop height
CropHeight.description: Requested output height for an aspect-constrained crop.

Orientation.label: Orientation
Orientation.description: Rotation/flip applied to the image (EXIF orientation code).

MaskGroupBasedCorrections.label: Masks
MaskGroupBasedCorrections.description: Current masking: a list of masks, each with its components (AI, brush, gradient, range) and local adjustment values.

GradientBasedCorrections.label: Linear gradients (legacy)
GradientBasedCorrections.description: Graduated filter adjustments from before the Masking tool.

CircularGradientBasedCorrections.label: Radial gradients (legacy)
CircularGradientBasedCorrections.description: Radial filter adjustments from before the Masking tool.

PaintBasedCorrections.label: Brush adjustments (legacy)
PaintBasedCorrections.description: Adjustment brush strokes from before the Masking tool.

RetouchAreas.label: Remove/heal spots
RetouchAreas.description: Remove, heal and clone spots with image coordinates; specific to one image.

RetouchInfo.label: Spot info (legacy)
RetouchInfo.description: Legacy spot removal data; specific to one image.

RedEyeInfo.label: Red eye
RedEyeInfo.description: Red eye corrections (pupil size, darken) with image coordinates; specific to one image.

EnhanceDenoiseAlreadyApplied.label: Denoise applied
EnhanceDenoiseAlreadyApplied.description: Records that AI Denoise was baked into this (Enhanced) DNG.

EnhanceDenoiseLumaAmount.label: Denoise amount
EnhanceDenoiseLumaAmount.description: Strength of the AI Denoise that was applied.

EnhanceDetailsAlreadyApplied.label: Raw Details applied
EnhanceDetailsAlreadyApplied.description: Records that Raw Details was baked into this DNG.

EnhanceSuperResolutionAlreadyApplied.label: Super Resolution applied
EnhanceSuperResolutionAlreadyApplied.description: Records that Super Resolution (2x linear resolution) was baked into this DNG.

LensBlur.label: Lens Blur
LensBlur.description: AI lens blur settings (blur amount, bokeh shape, focus range, refinement) as a structure.

HDREditMode.label: HDR edit mode
HDREditMode.description: Whether the photo is edited in HDR mode.

HDRMaxValue.label: HDR limit
HDRMaxValue.description: Highlight headroom of the HDR edit.

SDRBrightness.label: SDR rendition: Brightness
SDRBrightness.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRContrast.label: SDR rendition: Contrast
SDRContrast.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRClarity.label: SDR rendition: Clarity
SDRClarity.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRHighlights.label: SDR rendition: Highlights
SDRHighlights.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRShadows.label: SDR rendition: Shadows
SDRShadows.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRWhites.label: SDR rendition: Whites
SDRWhites.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

SDRBlend.label: SDR rendition: Blend
SDRBlend.description: SDR rendition setting used when an HDR edit is saved without HDR output.

amb:NegativeConvert.label: Convert negative
amb:NegativeConvert.description: True treats the photo as a scanned film negative and converts it to a positive. Everything else in the edit then works on the positive.

amb:NegativeType.label: Negative type
amb:NegativeType.description: "color" for colour negative film (orange base), "bw" for black-and-white negatives, "positive" for slide (reversal) film: no inversion, and the levels take out the light's colour. A black-and-white film stock also gives a black-and-white result.

amb:NegativeAuto.label: Auto
amb:NegativeAuto.description: True (the default) estimates the film base, levels and midtone for every photo. False uses the stored FilmBase*/NegativeDensity*/NegativeMidtone values (from `amb negative analyze`), which keeps a whole roll consistent; missing ones are still estimated.

amb:FilmStock.label: Film stock
amb:FilmStock.description: Film stock look applied during the conversion: neutral, warm-portrait-400, pastel-portrait-160, vivid-100, golden-200, everyday-400, cinema-500t, cinema-50d, bw-classic-400, bw-fine-100, bw-high-contrast, bw-red-filter, bw-orthochromatic. Our own looks, named by character; unknown names fall back to neutral.

amb:FilmStockAmount.label: Film stock amount
amb:FilmStockAmount.description: Strength of the film stock look, 0 = neutral conversion, 100 = full look.

amb:NegativeExposure.label: Print exposure
amb:NegativeExposure.description: Brightness of the conversion in stops (EV), before the regular Exposure slider.

amb:NegativeContrast.label: Print contrast
amb:NegativeContrast.description: Contrast of the conversion, like a paper grade: positive = harder, negative = softer.

amb:NegativeCyanRed.label: Cyan ↔ Red
amb:NegativeCyanRed.description: Colour balance of the conversion: positive adds red, negative adds cyan.

amb:NegativeMagentaGreen.label: Magenta ↔ Green
amb:NegativeMagentaGreen.description: Colour balance of the conversion: positive adds green, negative adds magenta.

amb:NegativeYellowBlue.label: Yellow ↔ Blue
amb:NegativeYellowBlue.description: Colour balance of the conversion: positive adds blue, negative adds yellow.

amb:NegativeToe.label: Toe
amb:NegativeToe.description: Shadow roll-off: positive lifts and softens the deepest shadows, negative makes them harder.

amb:NegativeShoulder.label: Shoulder
amb:NegativeShoulder.description: Highlight roll-off: positive compresses bright highlights (more detail, softer), negative makes them harder.

amb:NegativeSaturation.label: Film saturation
amb:NegativeSaturation.description: Colour saturation of the conversion, on top of the film stock's own.

amb:NegativeMidtone.label: Midtone
amb:NegativeMidtone.description: Which point of the negative's tonal range becomes middle grey (0..1). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:FilmBaseRed.label: Film base: red
amb:FilmBaseRed.description: Red transmittance of the unexposed film base (orange mask), as a fraction of the camera's white level. Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`; image- and scan-specific.

amb:FilmBaseGreen.label: Film base: green
amb:FilmBaseGreen.description: Green transmittance of the unexposed film base (orange mask), as a fraction of the camera's white level. Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`; image- and scan-specific.

amb:FilmBaseBlue.label: Film base: blue
amb:FilmBaseBlue.description: Blue transmittance of the unexposed film base (orange mask), as a fraction of the camera's white level. Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`; image- and scan-specific.

amb:NegativeDensityLowRed.label: Shadow density: red
amb:NegativeDensityLowRed.description: Red density above the film base that becomes the deepest shadow (black point of the red layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:NegativeDensityLowGreen.label: Shadow density: green
amb:NegativeDensityLowGreen.description: Green density above the film base that becomes the deepest shadow (black point of the green layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:NegativeDensityLowBlue.label: Shadow density: blue
amb:NegativeDensityLowBlue.description: Blue density above the film base that becomes the deepest shadow (black point of the blue layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:NegativeDensityHighRed.label: Highlight density: red
amb:NegativeDensityHighRed.description: Red density above the film base that becomes the deepest highlight (white point of the red layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:NegativeDensityHighGreen.label: Highlight density: green
amb:NegativeDensityHighGreen.description: Green density above the film base that becomes the deepest highlight (white point of the green layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

amb:NegativeDensityHighBlue.label: Highlight density: blue
amb:NegativeDensityHighBlue.description: Blue density above the film base that becomes the deepest highlight (white point of the blue layer). Set by Auto or `amb negative analyze`.

EnableToneCurve.label: Tone Curve on
EnableToneCurve.description: Tone Curve panel switch. False leaves the curves out of the render.

EnableColorAdjustments.label: Color Mixer on
EnableColorAdjustments.description: Color Mixer (HSL) panel switch. False leaves the colour mixer and Point Color out of the render.

EnableGrayscaleMix.label: B&W mixer on
EnableGrayscaleMix.description: B&W mixer switch. False leaves the mixer sliders out (the photo stays black and white if the treatment says so).

EnableSplitToning.label: Color Grading on
EnableSplitToning.description: Color Grading (Split Toning) panel switch. False leaves the grading and split toning out of the render.

EnableDetail.label: Detail on
EnableDetail.description: Detail panel switch. False turns sharpening and noise reduction off.

EnableLensCorrections.label: Lens Corrections on
EnableLensCorrections.description: Lens Corrections panel switch. False leaves the profile, chromatic aberration, manual distortion, vignetting and defringe out.

EnableEffects.label: Effects on
EnableEffects.description: Effects panel switch. False leaves the post-crop vignette and grain out of the render.

EnableTransform.label: Transform on
EnableTransform.description: Transform panel switch. False leaves Upright and the Transform sliders out of the render.

EnableCalibration.label: Calibration on
EnableCalibration.description: Calibration panel switch. False leaves the calibration sliders out of the render.

EnableRetouch.label: Spot removal on
EnableRetouch.description: Spot removal switch. False leaves the heal and clone spots out of the render.

EnableMaskGroupBasedCorrections.label: Masks on
EnableMaskGroupBasedCorrections.description: Masks panel switch. False leaves all masks out of the render.

EnableRedEye.label: Red eye on
EnableRedEye.description: Red eye switch. Red eye isn't rendered yet.

amb:LUT.label: LUT
amb:LUT.description: Path of a .cube file whose look is applied after the colour and curves, on sRGB-encoded values (colours outside sRGB are clipped for the table). Empty or unset: no LUT. The path is stored as is, so a sidecar moved to another computer needs the file there too.

amb:LUTAmount.label: LUT amount
amb:LUTAmount.description: How much of the LUT's look: 0 none, 100 all of it.
